phrases.speak: I built this with one prompt.
phrases.show: I BUILT THIS WITH ONE PROMPT!

phrases.speak: Meet Al Mutarid Mall, my interactive three D shopping mall project in Al Ain, U A E. It is a digital concept, not the real mall.
phrases.show: Al Mutarid Mall · Al Ain · UAE

phrases.speak: Walk through it in first person with W A S D, and drag to look around. Pick any venue from the directory and the camera walks you there. Click a sign to open its card. There are thirty two venues to explore: dine in, shops, and entertainment.
phrases.show: Walk, look, pick a venue, open its card.

phrases.speak: I started with one idea and described it to Claude Code. From there, the project became an interactive HTML experience. The whole mall lives in a single HTML file.
phrases.show: One idea, described to Claude Code.

phrases.speak: Under the hood it is HTML, CSS and JavaScript, rendered with the Three dot J S library. Built with Claude Code.
Then Vercel helped me bring the project online, making the interactive experience accessible through a web browser.
A final tour: golden ring lights, a glowing fountain, and signs for every venue.
From one prompt to an interactive three D world. What would you build next? Follow Agentoon dot A I for more real A I projects!
